title: Kildare street club.
html_source: First appears in Episode 5, Lotus Eaters, “Still Captain Buller broke a window in the Kildare street club with a slog to a square leg,” (5.560-61). Kildare street club is located at the entrance of Kildare street across from Trinity College Park.
